entries: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 `claude -p` 不再誤報沒登入
title.en: `claude -p` in cloud sessions no longer falsely reports "Not logged in"

body.zh-TW: 明明登入好了，腳本卻回你「Not logged in」，很容易讓人摸不著頭緒。這發生在雲端工作階段裡另外執行 `claude -p`（不開互動畫面、直接回一次答案）時：只要沒帶上該工作階段的環境變數，就會這樣誤報。現在不會了。
body.en: Running `claude -p` (which answers once without opening the interactive screen) inside a cloud session without that session's environment variables used to report "Not logged in", as if you had never signed in. It no longer does.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

title.zh-TW: 接很多 MCP 工具時，API 錯誤不再被誤報成對話太長
title.en: With many MCP tools, API errors are no longer mislabeled as "prompt is too long"

body.zh-TW: 明明才聊幾句，畫面卻說「prompt is too long」，你可能以為得開新對話了。這發生在接了很多 MCP 工具（讓 Claude 連外部服務的擴充）的工作階段：碰到 API 錯誤時，錯誤訊息會被換成這句。它還會順手做一次不必要的 compaction（把舊對話濃縮成摘要）。現在你看到的是原本的 API 錯誤，對話也不會白白被壓縮。
body.en: In sessions with many MCP tools (extensions that connect Claude to outside services), an API error used to show up as "prompt is too long", making you think the conversation had grown too long. It also triggered an unneeded compaction (condensing older conversation into a summary). Now you see the original API error, and your conversation is not compacted for nothing.

items.original: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

entries: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

entries: Added Auto mode on Windows 11 version 24H2 and later for personal Google Accounts, selectable via `--mode auto`, `Agent Mode` in `/config`, `Shift+Tab`, or Remote Control Settings (`Agent` remains the default).

Added whole-file toggle (`f`) and hunk folding (`Ctrl+O`) to `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` views in `/diff`, and consolidated `Per Turn` diffs so multiple edits to a file in one turn appear as a single combined diff.
Added `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` to MCP `tools/call` requests so MCP servers receive the top-level conversation ID even when a tool is called from a nested subagent.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that leave the terminal sandbox to include the assistant's preceding question on short replies like `yes`, check every subcommand in pipelines, and prompt before destructive Git or file commands.

Improved `agy plugin validate` with stricter checks across `plugin.json`, MCP server configs, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, bad variable placeholders, unrecognized hook tool matchers, and missing hook scripts.
Improved CPU and memory usage while streaming responses by caching streamed code-block syntax tokens, rendered Markdown blocks, and inline file-edit confirmation diffs across frames.
Improved `/compact` and automatic compaction to retain tool declarations on summarization requests so the model API reuses its cached prompt prefix.
Improved Remote Control on tablets and foldables to use the multi-pane layout with touch-sized controls instead of collapsing to the phone view, and kept popovers open while dragging scrollbars.

Fixed subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and fixed plugin-bundled subagents with `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricted MCP tools failing to start with `mcp spec not found for provider`.
Fixed rules and `SKILL.md` skills loading twice when discovered from both a standalone customization folder and an enabled plugin.
Fixed long rows wrapping instead of truncating at the terminal width in `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` lists, and `Per Turn` headers truncating prompts at 50 characters.
Fixed the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, dropdowns, or inline prompts, and blank gaps appearing above the prompt in `Medium` verbosity mode.
Fixed `Ctrl+Z` undo in the prompt mishandling pasted text, merging typing with recalled history entries, recording no-op `Backspace` or `Delete` steps, and truncating characters near emoji.
Fixed MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking when `tools/list` failed during server startup or when the CLI shut down while a server was connecting.
Fixed the system prompt's user rules wording so `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions instead of only instructions that follow them.
Fixed supported media attachments with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm; codecs=opus` being rejected as unsupported.

Fixed several UI issues in Remote Control, including clipped headers and dialogs on phones, iOS Safari zoom on input focus, `Enable Telemetry` and `Marketing Emails` reverting while Settings loads, and dragged URLs losing query or `#` parameters.

Fixed rendering and export bugs in Remote Control, including broken nested code blocks, `$VAR` shell variables parsed as LaTeX, broken media previews, blurry or blank diagrams in `Copy Image` and `Export as PDF`, and background-tab timer drift.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式登陸 Windows 11，加強沙盒外高風險指令審查
title.en: Auto Mode Arrives on Windows 11 with Stricter Out-of-Sandbox Command Review

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 11 24H2 或更新版本上使用個人 Google 帳戶時，現在你可以體驗能自行決定工具呼叫的 Auto 模式。⟦如同具備主動防護的車輛巡航系統，以前只照既定速限行駛而難以應對突發變換，現在遇到危險路況會主動放慢並要求駕駛接手確認。⟧你可以透過 `--mode auto` 參數、在 `/config` 設定選單的 Agent Mode 選取、按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Tab`，或是開啟 Remote Control 設定進行切換，預設選項仍維持為 Agent 模式。當 Auto 模式審查即將脫離終端機沙盒（sandbox，隔離指令執行的安全環境）的指令時，防護更為嚴謹。面對管線指令會逐一檢查其中的每個子指令；若是 `yes` 等簡短回覆，會連同助理的前一個提問一併納入評估，並在執行具破壞性的 Git 或檔案操作前主動跳出提示確認。
body.en: When running on Windows 11 24H2 or later with a personal Google account, you can now experience Auto mode, which decides tool calls on its own. ⟦Picture a car cruise control system with active safety: where it once only held a preset speed and struggled with sudden shifts, it now slows down on hazardous roads and prompts the driver to take over.⟧ You can switch modes via the `--mode auto` flag, by selecting Agent Mode in the `/config` settings menu, by pressing `Shift+Tab`, or by enabling Remote Control settings, while Agent mode remains the default. When Auto mode reviews commands about to leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated security environment for command execution), safeguards are significantly stricter. For pipeline commands, it inspects every sub-command individually; for short replies like `yes`, it evaluates them alongside the assistant's preceding question, prompting for confirmation before running destructive Git or file operations.

items.original:
Added Auto mode on Windows 11 version 24H2 and later for personal Google Accounts, selectable via `--mode auto`, `Agent Mode` in `/config`, `Shift+Tab`, or Remote Control Settings (`Agent` remains the default).
Improved Auto mode's review of commands that leave the terminal sandbox to include the assistant's preceding question on short replies like `yes`, check every subcommand in pipelines, and prompt before destructive Git or file commands.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援區塊折疊與整檔切換，修正清單換行與標題截斷
title.en: /diff Adds Hunk Folding and Full File Toggle, Fixing List Wrapping and Title Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入 `/diff` 檢視程式碼變更時，Commit Tree 與 Per Turn 兩種檢視模式新增了多項閱讀控制。⟦跟查閱裝訂成冊的工程藍圖一樣，以前只能整頁攤開翻找細節，現在可以隨手折疊次要章節，還能把同一次施工的多處修改彙整在同一份清單。⟧現在按下快捷鍵 `f` 可以切換顯示整份檔案，按下 `Ctrl+O` 則能折疊個別變更區塊（hunk，版本控制中連續的一段程式碼修改）。在 Per Turn 檢視中，同一輪對話內對同一檔案進行的多次編輯，會直接合併為單一比對畫面，不再被拆得零散。清單顯示的排版問題也已修復，清單中超出終端機寬度的長行會正常截斷而不再強行折行，Per Turn 頂部標題也不會再把提示詞截斷在 50 個字元。
body.en: When typing `/diff` in the terminal to inspect code changes, Commit Tree and Per Turn views add several reading controls. ⟦Like consulting a bound set of engineering blueprints where you previously had to spread out entire pages to search for details, you can now collapse secondary sections at will and consolidate edits from the same job into a single list.⟧ Pressing `f` now toggles the full file view, while `Ctrl+O` folds an individual hunk (a contiguous section of code changes in version control). In Per Turn view, multiple edits made to the same file within a single turn merge directly into a unified diff screen instead of being scattered. List formatting issues are also fixed: lines exceeding terminal width now truncate cleanly rather than wrapping forcefully, and Per Turn headers no longer truncate prompts at 50 characters.

items.original:
Added whole-file toggle (`f`) and hunk folding (`Ctrl+O`) to `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` views in `/diff`, and consolidated `Per Turn` diffs so multiple edits to a file in one turn appear as a single combined diff.
Fixed long rows wrapping instead of truncating at the terminal width in `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` lists, and `Per Turn` headers truncating prompts at 50 characters.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫支援追溯最上層對話，清理伺服器連線洩漏
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Support Root Conversation Tracing, Fixing Server Connection Leaks

body.zh-TW: 當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接自訂伺服器時，子代理呼叫工具的追蹤能力有了重大改善。⟦就像委託跨國快遞寄件，以前轉交給各區投遞員後就查不到源頭，現在每筆派工紀錄都烙印總單號，無論轉發幾手都能追溯最初的寄件委託。⟧現在即使工具是由深層的巢狀子代理所觸發，發出的 `tools/call` 請求都會自動帶上 `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` 欄位，讓外部伺服器能辨識最頂層的對話識別碼。在伺服器連線與資源釋放方面，先前若在伺服器啟動期間執行 `tools/list` 失敗，或是在連線尚未完成時直接關閉命令列工具，背景連線常式與用戶端工作階段容易殘留。這兩種情況造成的用戶端工作階段與背景連線常式洩漏，現在已修好。
body.en: When connecting custom servers with MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), tracking tool calls made by subagents is substantially improved. ⟦Think of shipping a package through an international courier: previously, handoffs to regional delivery agents obscured the origin, but now every dispatch record stamps a master tracking number so the initial request remains traceable across any number of transfers.⟧ Even when tools are invoked by deeply nested subagents, outgoing `tools/call` requests now automatically include the `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` field so external servers can identify the top-level conversation ID. In terms of server connections and resource cleanup, background connection routines and client sessions previously lingered if `tools/list` failed during startup or if the CLI closed before the connection finished. Leaks of client sessions and background connection routines caused by both scenarios are now resolved.

items.original:
Added `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` to MCP `tools/call` requests so MCP servers receive the top-level conversation ID even when a tool is called from a nested subagent.
Fixed MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking when `tools/list` failed during server startup or when the CLI shut down while a server was connecting.

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式驗證加強嚴格檢查，修復子代理繼承與技能重複載入
title.en: Plugin Validation Enforces Stricter Checks, Fixing Subagent Inheritance and Skill Duplication

body.zh-TW:
在開發或安裝自訂擴充套件時，外掛程式的驗證機制與執行環境獲得了多項修正。

指令 `agy plugin validate` 導入更嚴格的檢查，全面檢驗 `plugin.json`、MCP 伺服器設定、`hooks.json` 與 sidecar 清單，防範無效 JSON 語法、未知欄位、錯誤變數佔位符、無法辨識的掛鉤（hook，事件觸發時執行的自動腳本）工具比對器及遺失腳本。

子代理方面，修復了子代理遺失父工作階段繼承外掛的問題；若打包外掛的子代理設定 `plugins.inherit_user: false` 且限制 MCP 工具，先前啟動拋出 `mcp spec not found for provider` 的異常也已修復。

當自訂規則或 `SKILL.md` 技能同時存在於獨立客製化資料夾與已啟用外掛程式時，系統不再重複載入兩次。
body.en:
When developing or installing custom extensions, plugin validation mechanisms and execution environments received multiple fixes.

The `agy plugin validate` command introduces stricter checks that thoroughly inspect `plugin.json`, MCP server configurations, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests, guarding against invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, malformed variable placeholders, unrecognized tool matchers for hooks (automated scripts triggered by specific events), and missing scripts.

For subagents, an issue where subagents lost plugins inherited from parent sessions has been resolved. If a packaged plugin subagent sets `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricts MCP tools, the startup error throwing `mcp spec not found for provider` is also fixed.

When custom rules or `SKILL.md` skills exist simultaneously in standalone customization folders and enabled plugins, the system no longer loads them twice.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` with stricter checks across `plugin.json`, MCP server configs, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, bad variable placeholders, unrecognized hook tool matchers, and missing hook scripts.
Fixed subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and fixed plugin-bundled subagents with `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricted MCP tools failing to start with `mcp spec not found for provider`.
Fixed rules and `SKILL.md` skills loading twice when discovered from both a standalone customization folder and an enabled plugin.

title.zh-TW: 串流回應暫存降低資源消耗，壓縮請求保留工具宣告重用快取
title.en: Stream Response Caching Cuts Resource Overhead, Compaction Retains Tool Declarations

body.zh-TW: 當你請模型生成長篇回應或修改大量程式碼時，回應串流與對話壓縮的快取（cache，把處理過的結果暫存起來重複使用）機制減輕了運算負擔。⟦好比在料理檯旁備妥常備菜，已切洗好的食材直接下鍋而不重複動刀，收拾廚房時也把標準菜單留在黑板上，省去重新謄寫核對的時間。⟧在文字串流輸出期間，終端機現在會跨影格暫存程式碼區塊的語法標記（token，程式碼結構的分析記號）、算繪後的 Markdown 區塊，以及行內檔案編輯的確認比對畫面，降低 CPU 與記憶體使用量。而在執行 `/compact` 指令或系統觸發自動壓縮時，對話摘要請求會完整保留工具宣告，讓模型 API 能順暢重複使用先前已快取的提示詞前綴。
body.en: When asking models to generate lengthy responses or modify extensive code, caching mechanisms for response streaming and conversation compaction reduce computing overhead. ⟦Imagine keeping prepped ingredients ready by the kitchen counter, where washed and chopped items drop straight into the pot without re-cutting, while standard menus stay on the chalkboard during cleanup to save time re-copying.⟧ During streamed text output, the terminal now caches code-block syntax tokens (structural analysis units for code) across frames, along with rendered Markdown blocks and inline file edit confirmation diffs, lowering CPU and memory usage. When running `/compact` or when the system triggers automatic compaction, conversation summary requests preserve tool declarations intact, allowing model APIs to smoothly reuse previously cached prompt prefixes.

items.original:
Improved CPU and memory usage while streaming responses by caching streamed code-block syntax tokens, rendered Markdown blocks, and inline file-edit confirmation diffs across frames.
Improved `/compact` and automatic compaction to retain tool declarations on summarization requests so the model API reuses its cached prompt prefix.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援平板多欄排版，修正行動端介面與算繪錯誤
title.en: Remote Control Adds Multi-Column Layout on Tablets, Fixing Mobile UI and Rendering Bugs

body.zh-TW:
在平板與行動裝置上使用 Remote Control 遠端控制時，大螢幕排版與多項操作體驗獲得整體升級。

平板與摺疊螢幕裝置不再強制縮成單欄手機畫面，而是啟用具備觸控尺寸控制項的多欄排版，拖曳捲軸時彈出的控制面板（popover）也會持續保持開啟。

行動端的介面細節也獲得修正。手機上標題與對話框遭截斷、iOS Safari 點選輸入框時畫面被自動放大、設定載入中 Enable Telemetry 與 Marketing Emails 開關自行跳回，以及拖曳網址時遺失查詢參數或井字標記（#）的問題已全數排除。

輸出算繪與檔案匯出同樣更為穩定。先前巢狀程式碼區塊排版破裂、帶錢字號的 Shell 變數（$VAR）被誤判為 LaTeX 公式、媒體預覽無法載入、複製圖片或匯出 PDF 時圖表模糊或空白，以及背景分頁計時器偏差等現象，現在都已修正完畢。
body.en:
When using Remote Control on tablets and mobile devices, large-screen layouts and various operational experiences received an overall upgrade.

Tablets and foldable devices are no longer forced into a single-column phone view; instead, they enable a multi-column layout with touch-sized controls, and popover panels remain open while dragging scrollbars.

Mobile interface details have also been refined. Issues where titles and dialogs truncated on phones, tapping input fields in iOS Safari triggered automatic zoom, the Enable Telemetry and Marketing Emails toggles flipped back while settings loaded, and dragging URLs lost query parameters or hashes (#) are all resolved.

Output rendering and file exports are likewise more stable. Prior issues with broken nested code block layouts, Shell variables ($VAR) being misidentified as LaTeX formulas, media previews failing to load, blurry or blank charts when copying images or exporting PDFs, and background tab timer drift have all been fixed.

items.original:
Improved Remote Control on tablets and foldables to use the multi-pane layout with touch-sized controls instead of collapsing to the phone view, and kept popovers open while dragging scrollbars.
Fixed several UI issues in Remote Control, including clipped headers and dialogs on phones, iOS Safari zoom on input focus, `Enable Telemetry` and `Marketing Emails` reverting while Settings loads, and dragged URLs losing query or `#` parameters.
Fixed rendering and export bugs in Remote Control, including broken nested code blocks, `$VAR` shell variables parsed as LaTeX, broken media previews, blurry or blank diagrams in `Copy Image` and `Export as PDF`, and background-tab timer drift.

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框回歸底部定位，修復 Ctrl+Z 復原與表情符號截斷
title.en: Terminal Input Box Re-Anchors to Bottom, Fixing Ctrl+Z Undo and Emoji Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中與模型對話時，輸入框的排版位置與文字復原行為迎來了重要修正。⟦正如在紙上書寫與擦拭草稿，以前橡皮擦常常擦掉多餘的字跡甚至弄縐紙張，現在每一次復原動作都能精準撤回上一筆紀錄。⟧先前當你關閉面板、下拉選單或行內提示時，輸入框有時會卡在螢幕中間不回彈，在 Medium 詳細度模式下輸入框上方還會出現空白縫隙；現在這些排版異常都已修復，輸入列會穩定貼齊底部。文字編輯方面，快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z 的復原機制已重新調整。過去貼上文字時復原容易錯亂，新輸入的內容甚至會與歷史紀錄錯誤合併。現在無作用的退格鍵與 Delete 不再被記錄為多餘步驟，在表情符號（emoji）旁執行刪除或復原時，也不會再發生字元遭到截斷的狀況。
body.en: When chatting with models in the terminal, the input box layout position and text undo behavior received major fixes. ⟦A writer sketching and erasing drafts on paper once risked smudging extra marks or wrinkling the sheet, but now each undo step accurately retracts the previous entry.⟧ Previously, closing panels, dropdown menus, or inline prompts could leave the input box stuck midway up the screen, and a blank gap appeared above the input box in Medium verbosity mode; these layout anomalies are now resolved, keeping the input bar securely anchored to the bottom. For text editing, the Ctrl+Z undo mechanism has been retuned. Pasting text previously scrambled undo history, sometimes incorrectly merging newly typed content with older history. Ineffective Backspace and Delete keystrokes are no longer recorded as extra steps, and deleting or undoing next to emojis (pictographic symbols) no longer causes characters to be truncated.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, dropdowns, or inline prompts, and blank gaps appearing above the prompt in `Medium` verbosity mode.
Fixed `Ctrl+Z` undo in the prompt mishandling pasted text, merging typing with recalled history entries, recording no-op `Backspace` or `Delete` steps, and truncating characters near emoji.

title.zh-TW: 修正規則優先順序措辭，明確涵蓋前方內建指示
title.en: Clarify Rule Precedence Phrasing to Explicitly Cover Earlier Built-In Instructions

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案根目錄撰寫自訂規範時，可以留意系統提示詞對規則優先順序的說明。以前系統提示詞（system prompt，引導 AI 行為的核心指示）的措辭，只寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 的使用者規則可覆寫排在它們後方的指示。現在系統提示詞明確寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 規則可覆寫較早出現的內建指示。
body.en: When writing custom rules in project roots, note the updated system prompt phrasing for rule precedence. Phrasing in the system prompt (core instructions guiding AI behavior) previously only stated that user rules in GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md could override instructions placed after them. The system prompt now explicitly clarifies that GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md rules can override earlier built-in instructions.

items.original: Fixed the system prompt's user rules wording so `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions instead of only instructions that follow them.

title.zh-TW: 支援帶編碼參數的媒體附件，避免音訊檔案遭錯誤拒絕
title.en: Support Media Attachments with Codec Parameters, Preventing Erroneous Audio Rejections

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機對話中上傳音訊或多媒體檔案時，附件格式的相容性獲得了修正。以前若媒體附件的 MIME 類型（標示附件內容格式的類型名稱）帶有額外參數，例如常見的音訊格式 audio/webm; codecs=opus，會被誤判為不支援而直接遭到拒絕。這類原本受支援的附件，現在不會再因 MIME 類型帶有參數而被誤拒。
body.en: When uploading audio or multimedia files in terminal conversations, attachment format compatibility has been fixed. Previously, if a media attachment's MIME type (a label identifying attachment content formats) included extra parameters, such as the common audio format audio/webm; codecs=opus, it was incorrectly flagged as unsupported and rejected. Such natively supported attachments are no longer falsely rejected due to parameterized MIME types.

items.original: Fixed supported media attachments with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm; codecs=opus` being rejected as unsupported.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

items.original:
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: /blender 指令登場，參考圖直接重建為 3D 可編輯場景
title.en: /blender Command Debuts to Reconstruct Reference Images Directly into Editable 3D Scenes

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊有一張概念設計圖或參考照片，想快速建立立體模型時，往往需要在建模程式裡從零搭建物件與燈光。新推出的 `/blender` 指令能依據參考圖片，自動重建出可自由編輯的 Blender（一套開源三維繪圖工具）場景。⟦就像拿著一張平面設計草圖走進工作室，模型師當場組裝出能拆卸零件、隨意更換視角的立體模型。⟧這讓你省去繁瑣的手動對位，產出的檔案也能立刻在編輯器內接續調整視角、材質與燈光。
body.en:
When you have a concept design sketch or reference photo and want to quickly create a 3D model, you often need to build objects and lighting from scratch in modeling software. The newly introduced `/blender` command automatically reconstructs a freely editable Blender (an open-source 3D modeling tool) scene based on reference images.

⟦Picture walking into a studio with a 2D design sketch, where a modeler immediately assembles a 3D model with detachable parts and freely adjustable viewing angles on the spot.⟧

This saves you from tedious manual alignment, and the generated files can immediately be used to adjust perspectives, materials, and lighting directly in the editor.

items.original: Added `/blender` to reconstruct reference images as editable Blender scenes

title.zh-TW: 電腦操作精簡工具呼叫，跳過重複查閱與多餘清單直奔目標
title.en: Computer Use Streamlines Tool Calls, Skipping Redundant Checks and Lists to Head Straight for Goals

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代理操作桌面螢幕時，每多呼叫一次工具，都會拉長等待時間並消耗額度。電腦操作（Computer Use，讓 AI 透過視覺畫面模擬人類點擊與輸入的機制）現在減少了許多冗餘的工具呼叫。當任務明確指定某個應用程式時，它會直接啟動該程式，不再先列出所有應用程式清單；遇到檔案或系統查詢，會直接以終端機指令回答；它還會跳過重複閱讀自身說明的動作。⟦好比熟練的助理接獲指令便立刻動手，不再反覆翻閱員工手冊或把工具箱裡的物件逐一清點一遍。⟧就算畫面當下看起來像是已經做完，它仍會依照指示確實執行任務。
body.en:
When having an AI agent operate desktop screens, every extra tool call prolongs waiting times and consumes quota. Computer Use (a mechanism that lets AI simulate human clicks and keystrokes through visual screens) now cuts out many redundant tool calls. When a task explicitly specifies an application, it launches that program directly instead of first listing all applications. When encountering file or system queries, it answers directly with terminal commands. It also skips repeatedly re-reading its own instructions.

⟦Think of a skilled assistant getting straight to work upon receiving an order, instead of repeatedly leafing through the employee handbook or counting every item in the toolbox.⟧

Even if the screen currently looks like the task is already finished, it still carries out the assignment faithfully according to instructions.

items.original: Computer Use makes fewer tool calls: it skips re-reading its own instructions, opens the app a task clearly points to without listing apps first, answers file and system questions with the shell, and does the task even when the screen already looks done

title.zh-TW: 背景任務提示頻率降至單次，監聽狀態即刻顯示且長程目標不中斷
title.en: Background Task Prompts Reduced to Once, Displaying Listening States Instantly Without Halting Goal Runs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動耗時較長的工作時，對話視窗的提示頻率與狀態顯示有了更清晰的安排。執行超過 30 分鐘的背景指令，現在只會主動提示代理一次，不再每隔半小時就提醒，需要時由代理自行排定後續檢查時機。當代理收到長時間背景指令的提示時，對話紀錄會顯示「Waiting for background task」，讓你明白它為何開始動作；針對仍在執行的背景指令，重複發出的等待請求也不再卡住整個等待時間。即使電腦負載偏高或硬碟緩慢，新啟動的監聽器也會即刻出現在頁尾與 `/tasks` 清單中。在長程目標模式（goal run，讓 AI 自主推進多步驟目標的執行流程）下，若工具執行後產生了新的下一步指引，它會替換既有指引並繼續前進，不再提早停下；僅在指引完全相同時才會如常停止。
body.en: When launching long-running jobs in the terminal, prompt frequencies and status displays in conversation windows are now arranged much more clearly. Background commands running longer than 30 minutes will now proactively prompt the agent only once instead of reminding it every half hour, leaving the agent to schedule follow-up checks when needed. When an agent receives a prompt for a long-running background command, the conversation log displays "Waiting for background task" so you understand why it started taking action. Repeated wait requests for background commands that are still executing no longer stall the entire wait duration. Even under heavy machine load or slow disk speeds, newly started listeners appear immediately in the footer and the `/tasks` list. In goal run mode (an execution flow where AI autonomously advances multi-step goals), if a tool run produces new next-step guidance, it replaces existing guidance and continues moving forward rather than stopping early. It only stops as usual when the guidance is completely identical.

items.original:
A background command that runs past 30 minutes now prompts the agent once instead of every 30 minutes; the agent schedules its own later check if it needs one
The transcript shows "Waiting for background task" when the agent is prompted about a long-running background command, so you can see why it started working
A duplicate wait for a background command that is still running no longer holds the chat for its full requested wait
A monitor you start now appears in the footer and in `/tasks` right away, even when the machine is busy or the disk is slow
A long goal run no longer stops early when fresh next-step guidance replaces still-active guidance after new tool work; identical guidance still stops as before

title.zh-TW: 沙盒環境嚴格隔離設定目錄，Git 技能禁止擅自隱藏未追蹤檔案
title.en: Sandbox Environment Strictly Isolates Config Directories, Forbidding Git Skill from Hiding Untracked Files

body.zh-TW: 把終端機指令交給 AI 時，機密資料與檔案庫的安全界線至關重要。沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行的受限環境）指令，無法再讀取或修改 `~/.config/muse`、`~/.config/tbh` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 下的登入資訊、設定、核准規則與被封鎖程式。任務只要求乾淨工作樹時，Git 技能拒絕用忽略規則或 stash 隱藏未追蹤檔案。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）參數 `model_provider` 改標註模型供應商；僅 Meta 閘道列為 Meta 擁有的模型回報 `meta`，其餘省略，其上的 Claude 或 GPT 工作階段不再回報為 `meta`。⟦像訪客證開不了保險櫃，清潔工也不准把雜物塞進抽屜掩蓋混亂。⟧
body.en:
When delegating terminal commands to AI, the security boundaries of sensitive credentials and repositories are critical. Sandboxed commands (a restricted environment for isolated execution) can no longer read or modify login credentials, settings, approval rules, or blocked applications under `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh`, or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. When a task only requires a clean worktree, the Git skill refuses to hide untracked files using ignore rules or stash. The hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) parameter `model_provider` now indicates the model provider. Only models listed as Meta-owned by the Meta gateway report `meta`, while others omit it, so Claude or GPT sessions running on it no longer report `meta`.

⟦Just as a visitor badge cannot open a safe, a cleaner is also forbidden to shove clutter into drawers to hide a mess.⟧

items.original:
Security: Sandboxed commands can no longer read or change sign-in details, settings, approval rules or blocked apps stored in `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh` or the same folders under `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`
Security: The git skill now refuses to hide your untracked files with ignore rules or a stash when a task only asks for a clean tree
Security: Hook input `model_provider` now names the vendor of the selected model instead of the connection it was routed through: it is `meta` only for a model the built-in Meta gateway catalog lists as Meta-owned, and is omitted otherwise, so a Claude or GPT session on the Meta gateway no longer reports `meta`

title.zh-TW: 工作流程子任務獨立重試，崩潰重啟精準標記中斷狀態
title.en: Workflow Subtasks Retry Independently, Accurately Tagging Interrupted States upon Crash Restarts

body.zh-TW: 執行包含多個子任務的工作流程時，單一環節發生中斷不再導致整個流程無故卡死。如果工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動化執行的機制）的子任務因啟動紀錄無法儲存，或該任務已存有另一筆不同的啟動紀錄而停止，現在會以白話說明未執行任何新操作、其餘子任務仍持續運作，並指引下一步做法。排定重試後立刻遭中斷的任務，恢復時會依照原記錄的模型與思考力度接續運作。若恢復的任務初次儲存在任何內容寫入前就失敗，僅有該任務會重試而非中斷整個流程；重試的儲存再失敗，也僅標記該任務失敗，並告訴你下一步該怎麼做。遇崩潰重新啟動時，若已終止的代理重啟遭拒，其紀錄列會直接標為失敗並讓整體流程完工，不再誤顯為執行中。
body.en: When executing workflows containing multiple subtasks, an interruption in a single step no longer stalls the entire flow without explanation. If a subtask in a workflow (a mechanism that chains multiple subtasks for automated execution) stops because its launch record cannot be saved, or because a different launch record already exists for it, it now explains in plain language that no new operations were run, confirms that other subtasks are still running, and guides next steps. Tasks interrupted immediately after scheduling a retry will resume operation using the originally recorded model and reasoning effort. If an initial save of a resumed task fails before any content is written, only that task retries instead of interrupting the entire workflow. If the retried save fails again, it only marks that task as failed and tells you what to do next. Upon restarting after a crash, if a terminated agent is rejected for restart, its record row is directly marked as failed and allows the overall workflow to finish, rather than mistakenly displaying as running.

items.original:
A Workflow child that stops because its start record can't be saved, or because a different start record was already saved for it, now says in plain words that nothing new ran, that the other Workflow children keep running, and what to do next
A Workflow task that was interrupted right after it scheduled a retry now resumes with its recorded model and effort instead of being held
When a resumed Workflow task's first save fails before anything is written, only that task retries instead of the whole Workflow stopping; if the retry's save fails too, only that task fails and tells you what to do next
A Workflow resumed after a crash no longer shows a killed agent as still running when its relaunch is refused before it starts; the killed attempt's row now ends Failed and the Workflow completes

title.zh-TW: 工作流程恢復後保留自訂名稱，控制台與即時進度完整顯示
title.en: Workflows Retain Custom Names After Resuming, Displaying Fully in Console and Live Progress

body.zh-TW: 為工作流程取了清楚好記的專屬名稱，卻常在重新啟動或查閱紀錄時被打回預設代號。現在工作流程中途暫停並重新恢復後，各項流程訊息與結束提示都會完整保留先前記錄的自訂名稱。控制室面板以及點開的執行結果頁面，也會持續顯示該流程原本的名稱。新儲存的流程歷史紀錄與即時動態更新都會採用所記錄的名稱；如果遇上過去未儲存名稱的舊版執行紀錄，介面則會明確標記為「name unavailable」，方便你清楚辨識。⟦跟在專案檔案夾貼上手寫標籤一樣，中途交接給其他班次時，標籤依然牢牢貼在封面，不再因為換人接手就退回空白編號。⟧
body.en:
Giving a workflow a clear and memorable custom name often used to result in it reverting to a default identifier upon restarting or checking records. Now, after a workflow is paused mid-run and resumed, workflow messages and finish prompts fully retain the previously recorded custom name. The Mission Control panel and opened run result pages also consistently display the workflow's original name. Newly saved workflow history records and real-time live updates will use the recorded name. If encountering legacy execution records where names were not previously saved, the interface clearly marks them as "name unavailable" for easy identification.

⟦Much like a handwritten label taped to a project folder stays firmly on the cover during a handover to another shift, it no longer reverts to a blank number just because someone else took over.⟧

items.original:
Workflow messages and exit prompts keep the recorded name after resume
Workflow control rooms and opened results keep the recorded workflow name
Newly saved workflow history and live updates use recorded names, with "name unavailable" for older runs that have none

title.zh-TW: 子代理忠實遵從自訂思考力度，支援父任務等待時並行處理
title.en: Subagents Faithfully Honor Custom Reasoning Effort, Supporting Concurrent Processing While Parent Waits

body.zh-TW: 調派多個子代理分頭協同作業時，每位代理的推理深度與模型指派現在都能精準維持。透過工作階段協定啟動的工作階段，現在會遵循所儲存的思考力度（reasoning effort，決定模型在回答前投入多少深度推理的參數）。子代理會嚴格遵循其代理定義中設定的思考力度與專屬模型；當定義的模型無法使用時，會發出通知並改為備援使用當前工作階段的模型。若工作流程中的子代理指名了你工作階段的模型，即使該模型在重啟後被隱藏或自模型清單中移除，子代理依然會維持運行。在父代理處於等待狀態時，子代理現在獲准同步處理待處理的結果，不再平白枯等。⟦彷彿專案主管在等待外部回覆時，被分派任務的助理無須跟著停工，能繼續整理其他已送達的數據資料。⟧
body.en:
When dispatching multiple subagents to collaborate on tasks, the reasoning depth and model assignment of each agent can now be maintained precisely. Sessions launched via the session protocol now follow the saved reasoning effort (a parameter determining how much deep reasoning the model invests before answering). Subagents strictly adhere to the reasoning effort and dedicated model specified in their agent definitions. When a defined model is unavailable, a notification is sent, and it falls back to using the current session's model instead. If a subagent in a workflow specifies your session's model, it keeps running even if that model is hidden or removed from the model catalog after a restart. While the parent agent is in a waiting state, subagents are now permitted to process pending results concurrently instead of waiting idly.

⟦Imagine a project manager waiting for an external reply, where assigned assistants need not sit idle and can keep organizing other data that has already arrived.⟧

items.original:
Sessions started through the session protocol honor saved reasoning effort
Subagents now honor the reasoning effort set in their agent definition
A Workflow subagent that named your session's model keeps running after a restart even when that model is now hidden or missing from the model list, the same as one that left the model out
Subagents use their definition's model, falling back to the session model with a notice when unavailable
Allow subagents to process pending results while the parent waits

title.zh-TW: muse serve 載入對話不再卡死其他請求，健全歷史還原與帳號指引
title.en: muse serve No Longer Blocks Other Requests While Loading Chats, Solidifying History Restoration and Account Guidance

body.zh-TW: 將 Muse 當作本機背景伺服器運行時，多個工作階段並行存取的排程機制有了顯著改善。當你透過 `muse serve` 處理龐大對話時，伺服器在首次載入歷史紀錄、恢復或分支工作階段、開啟側邊對話、列出待審批項目或讀取工具輸出時，都能持續回應其他請求，不再拖住其他對話；嘗試恢復載入中的工作階段也會依序等待，而非誤報已被佔用。它現在能直接顯示 Muse 1.4.8 仍運行中的對話紀錄，即便儲存檢視檔案遭刪除也能正常還原。若啟動時缺乏模型清單且帳號需補填付款方式、新手導覽或年齡確認，對話輪次會明確說明該做什麼，不再無端要求重新登入。
body.en: When running Muse as a local background server, the scheduling mechanism for concurrent session access has improved significantly. When handling large conversations via `muse serve`, the server continues responding to other requests while initially loading history, resuming or branching sessions, opening side chats, listing pending approval items, or reading tool outputs, without stalling other conversations. Attempts to resume a session that is currently loading will now wait in turn rather than falsely reporting that it is already occupied. It can now directly display ongoing conversation records from Muse 1.4.8 and cleanly restore them even if saved view files were deleted. If the model list is missing at startup and the account requires adding a payment method, completing onboarding, or confirming age, the turn explicitly explains what needs to be done instead of prompting for a re-login without explanation.

items.original:
`muse serve` now shows the history of a session that Muse 1.4.8 is still running, instead of failing to read it until that session closes
When a `muse serve` client resumes a chat whose saved history view file was deleted, the chat shows its history again instead of none
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while a long session's history loads for the first time, and resuming a session that is still loading waits for it instead of reporting the session as in use
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while it resumes or forks a long session, opens a side chat on one, lists its pending approvals or reads one of its tool outputs, instead of stalling every other thread until that session's history is read
When `muse serve` starts with no saved model list and your account still needs a payment method, onboarding or age confirmation, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again

title.zh-TW: 手動壓縮支援外接工具，修正檢查點儲存並加速大型工作階段分支
title.en: Manual Compaction Supports External Tools, Fixing Checkpoint Saves and Accelerating Large Session Branching

body.zh-TW: 對話內容過長而需要精簡上下文時，手動輸入 `/compact` 的觸發條件與儲存機制現在更為可靠。設定了外接工具 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的工作階段，現在可以直接執行手動 `/compact`，不再回報無可壓縮內容。在儲存檢查點時若恰好遇到其他寫入操作，不會再遺漏儲存；重新開啟已儲存的對話後，壓縮也能持續正常運作，不再重複摘要並最終報錯。如果在送出模型請求前就取消訊息，執行壓縮會如實回報沒有內容可摘要，避免留下錯誤檢查點而導致後續跳過開發者指令。當工具結果被清除或提醒過期時，`/compact` 的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計算已獲修正；在經歷壓縮的超大型工作階段中，執行 `/btw`、`/side` 與 `/fork` 的開啟速度也明顯加快。
body.en: When conversations grow too long and context needs trimming, the trigger conditions and saving mechanisms for manually running `/compact` are now much more reliable. Sessions configured with external MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol enabling AI to connect to external tools) tools can now directly run manual `/compact` without reporting that there is nothing to compact. Saving a checkpoint while another write operation is occurring no longer drops the save. After reopening a saved conversation, compaction continues working normally rather than repeatedly summarizing and ultimately erroring out. If a message is canceled before sending the model request, running compaction accurately reports that there is no content to summarize, preventing invalid checkpoints that could cause subsequent developer instructions to be skipped. The token (a text unit for AI processing and billing) calculation for `/compact` has been corrected when tool results are cleared or reminders expire. In very large compacted sessions, opening speeds for running `/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` are also noticeably faster.

items.original:
Manual `/compact` now compacts sessions with MCP servers configured, instead of answering "no compactable run is available"
A context compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when another session write lands while that checkpoint is being saved
Running /compact in a chat whose turns all ended before any model request (for example, a message cancelled before Muse began preparing its model request) now reports that there is nothing to summarize instead of writing a summary checkpoint that could later let the chat skip setting up its developer instructions
Compaction keeps working after you reopen a saved chat, instead of summarizing again at every boundary and eventually failing with "could not prepare the conversation"
Correct `/compact` token counts when tool results are cleared or reminders expire
`/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` open faster in very large compacted sessions

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復嚴格檢驗啟動紀錄，掛鉤只在紀錄完整時觸發執行
title.en: Session Resumption Strictly Verifies Startup Logs, Firing Hooks Only When Logs Are Fully Intact

body.zh-TW: 重新開啟先前儲存的對話時，若背後的執行紀錄曾發生缺損，盲目載入往往會引發非預期的錯誤。如果工作階段的日誌無法證實其最後一次啟動紀錄，現在會直接拒絕恢復該對話，並在訊息中點名損毀的紀錄，不再默默開啟。在終端機介面恢復工作階段時，只有日誌能證實啟動完整的對話才會觸發 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），其來源會標註為 `resume`。若對象是從未啟動的分支副本，來源則標註為 `fork`。若是無法證實啟動的副本，則完全不執行掛鉤並在啟動通知中說明。已儲存的工作階段格式也新增了標記欄位，可記錄儲存當下是否仍在啟動中；雖然目前尚未正式寫入，但未來一旦開始記錄，舊版 Muse 將拒絕開啟這類工作階段以防出錯。
body.en: When reopening a previously saved conversation, blindly loading it often causes unexpected errors if the underlying execution logs were corrupted. If a session log cannot verify its last startup record, it now explicitly refuses to resume that conversation and names the corrupted record in the message, rather than opening silently. When resuming a session in the terminal interface, only conversations whose startup can be verified by the log will trigger the SessionStart hook (a small program triggered by a specific event), with its source marked as `resume`. For branched copies that have never been started, the source is marked as `fork`. For copies whose startup cannot be verified, the hook is not executed at all, and an explanation is provided in the startup notification. The saved session format also adds a flag field to record whether it was still starting up at the time of saving. Although not actively written yet, once recorded in the future, legacy versions of Muse will refuse to open such sessions to prevent errors.

items.original:
Saved sessions can record whether a run was still starting when they were saved; nothing records it yet, so no session opens differently today, and once a later Muse records it, Muse versions released before that one will not open such a session
Resuming a session whose log cannot prove its last start is refused with a message naming the broken record instead of opening silently
SessionStart hooks run on every resumed TUI session whose log proves its last start, reporting `resume` (or `fork` for a never-activated clone) as their source; a replayed copy that cannot prove it runs none and says so in its startup notice

title.zh-TW: 跨桌面與終端切換即時同步對話，分支重試具備冪等性不再撞號
title.en: Real-time conversation sync across desktop and terminal switches, with idempotent branch retries that prevent collisions

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式與終端機之間切換工作環境時，不同版本之間的對話紀錄接軌現在省去了不必要的等待。若桌面端與終端機運行的 Muse Code 版本不同，切換時會直接同步另一端剛進行的簡短對話，不再從頭重新建構歷史紀錄（自 1.4.9 以前版本升級後的首次開啟仍會重建一次）。恢復進度落後的對話時，會在同一次恢復中直接補齊最新紀錄，不再出現歷史空白或遺漏即時回覆。使用相同指令識別碼重試分支時，會符合冪等（idempotent，多次執行結果與單次相同）原則直接回傳原始結果，不再報錯；指定不同切分時則維持衝突。即使對話含有中途送達的背景任務通知，分支在應用程式與 SDK 也能順利載入。工作階段中模型重複使用工具識別碼不再破壞後續壓縮，載入重複核准紀錄的工作階段時記憶體消耗也明顯降低。
body.en: When switching work environments between the desktop application and the terminal, bridging conversation history across different versions now eliminates unnecessary waiting. If the desktop app and terminal run different versions of Muse Code, switching will directly sync recent short conversations from the other side rather than rebuilding history from scratch (the first launch after upgrading from versions prior to 1.4.9 still rebuilds once). When restoring a conversation that has fallen behind, the latest records are backfilled in the same restoration pass, preventing history gaps or missing real-time replies. When retrying a branch using the same command identifier, it adheres to idempotent principles (yielding identical results when run multiple times as when run once) and directly returns the original result instead of throwing an error. Specifying a different split continues to raise a conflict. Even if a conversation contains background task notifications delivered midway, branches load smoothly across both the application and the SDK. A model reusing tool identifiers within a session no longer breaks subsequent compaction, and memory consumption drops significantly when loading sessions with duplicate approval records.

items.original:
A forked chat whose history has a background-task notice delivered mid-turn now opens in apps and SDKs in more cases, instead of failing to load
Switching a conversation between the desktop app and the terminal when they run different versions of Muse Code now catches up a short exchange made on the other side instead of rebuilding its saved history from scratch; the first open after updating from a release before 1.4.9 still rebuilds it once
Resuming a thread whose saved history had fallen far behind now brings it up to date in that same resume, instead of showing no history and missing live replies until the next resume
A session whose model reused a tool call id for two same-length results no longer becomes impossible to resume or compact after old tool results are cleared
Retrying a fork with the same command id now returns the original outcome instead of answering command_id_conflict, matching gate-off idempotency; reusing a command id with a different cut still conflicts
Reduce memory use when loading sessions with repeated approval records

title.zh-TW: 長篇分析回答改用短句分段，隱藏無回應標記並自動補問
title.en: Long analytical responses switch to short-sentence paragraphs, hiding no-reply markers with automatic follow-up questions

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產生的長篇分析報告時，密密麻麻的一整片文字往往讓人難以快速抓住重點。現在遇到長篇分析類型的回答，模型會主動採用短句與精簡段落進行排版，取代過去整面難以閱讀的文字牆。若先前對話中途意外中斷，使得某一輪的最終結果只剩下一行「前一輪未產生助手回覆」的內部標記，Muse 會自動發起一次有限度的重新提問，為你取得真正的實質回覆，並在執行摘要中主動剔除該標記。對話紀錄面板也不再顯示帶有菱形符號的「◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]」提示列；如果回答只包含該標記，畫面不會渲染任何內容，若標記後方附有正常回答，則只乾淨呈現正式的回答內容。⟦恰似專業編輯重新編排文稿，不僅將密集論述切成清晰段落，也在印製時主動抽除排版留下的空白除錯標記。⟧
body.en: When reading long analytical reports generated by AI, dense walls of text often make it hard to quickly grasp key points. When encountering long analytical responses, the model now proactively formats output using short sentences and concise paragraphs, replacing the previously unreadable walls of text. If a previous conversation was interrupted unexpectedly so that a turn's final output was left with only an internal marker indicating that the prior turn produced no assistant reply, Muse automatically issues a bounded re-prompt to retrieve a genuine response, actively stripping that marker from the run summaries. The conversation history panel also no longer displays the prompt bar `◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]` with its diamond symbol. If a response contains only that marker, the screen renders nothing, and if normal answers follow the marker, it cleanly presents only the formal response content. ⟦A professional editor reformats a manuscript by breaking dense arguments into clear paragraphs and stripping out leftover blank debugging marks before printing.⟧

items.original:
Long analysis answers use short sentences and paragraphs instead of dense walls of text
A turn whose final answer consists only of the "[Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" marker now gets one bounded re-prompt for a real reply, and the marker is stripped from run summaries
The transcript no longer shows a "◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" row — a reply containing only that resume marker renders nothing, and a real answer prefixed by it shows just the answer

title.zh-TW: 開發者指令阻擋改以白話引導，SDK 撤回狀態與技能範例修復
title.en: Developer command blocks switch to plain-language guidance, and SDK retraction states and skill examples receive fixes

body.zh-TW: 串接工具時，晦澀報錯常令人卡關。EdenFS 查全庫 Sapling（`hg files`、`hg locate`、`hg manifest`）卡死前阻擋，改指引 `search` 或 `hg biggrep`。衍生子行程遭拒改以白話說明，不再顯示內部列舉代碼。連接外部工具的 MCP 伺服器啟動存活未回，改報 `the server did not respond during startup` 而非泛用逾時。TypeScript 與 Python SDK 撤回遭拒不再誤標撤回或丟棄；前者的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 納入 `turn/retracted`，窮舉比對需補分支。內建 Three.js 技能改用可運作的 WebGPU 後製，不再引用已移除舊檔。
body.en: When integrating tools, cryptic error messages often cause roadblocks. Sapling repository-wide queries on EdenFS (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) are blocked before hanging, redirecting users to `search` or `hg biggrep`. Spawned subprocess rejections are now explained in plain language instead of displaying internal enum codes. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server fails to respond during startup liveness checks, it now reports `the server did not respond during startup` instead of a generic timeout. Retraction rejections in the TypeScript and Python SDKs are no longer mistakenly marked as retracted or dropped. The former's `StaleDroppableMethod` now incorporates `turn/retracted`, requiring an additional branch for exhaustive matching. The built-in Three.js skill now switches to working WebGPU post-processing instead of referencing removed legacy files.

items.original:
Spawn rejection hints now explain the reason in plain words instead of internal enum names
Repository-wide Sapling file listings (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) on EdenFS checkouts are refused before they hang, pointing at `search` or `hg biggrep` instead
An MCP server whose process stays alive but never responds during startup now fails with `the server did not respond during startup` instead of the generic operation timeout
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer mark a turn retracted, or drop its completion, when its retract is declined; in the TypeScript SDK, `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `turn/retracted`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case
The bundled Three.js skill now gives a working WebGPU post-processing example instead of one that imports a file current three.js no longer ships

entries: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.

title.zh-TW: Muse 額度用完即使未給數字，卡片也會標示 5 小時已用滿
title.en: Cards mark the 5-hour quota as full even when Muse provides no numbers upon exhaustion

body.zh-TW: 當你連續使用 Muse 處理工作時，一旦額度耗盡，往往會想確認何時才能繼續。以往 5 小時額度一用完，Muse 通常會直接拒絕額度查詢，只拋出「Subscription quota exhausted」錯誤訊息並告知重置時間，導致卡片拿不到具體數字。⟦跟運動場地的租借機一樣，以前名額一被搶光，票機只印出額滿通知與下一場時間，看板卻因抓不到剩餘數值而沒能更新；現在螢幕會直接標示目前時段已全滿，並貼上下次開放進場的時刻。⟧現在卡片遇到這種狀況，會主動把 5 小時額度顯示為 100%，並附上該重置時間。因為這項錯誤回報裡沒有週額度數字，所以卡片上的週額度百分比會沿用上次的讀數，卡片也保留「上次查詢」的時間提示，讓你在等待額度恢復時依然能掌握先前的用量狀態。
body.en: When you use Muse continuously for work, you often want to confirm when you can resume once your quota runs out. Previously, as soon as the 5-hour quota was exhausted, Muse would typically reject quota queries outright, only throwing a "Subscription quota exhausted" error message alongside the reset time, leaving the card without concrete numbers. ⟦Much like a sports venue reservation kiosk, where the ticket machine previously printed only a full notice and the next session time once slots filled up, leaving the display unupdated because it could not fetch the remaining count, the screen now directly marks the current slot as completely full and displays the time for the next admission.⟧ Now when encountering this situation, the card proactively displays the 5-hour quota at 100% and attaches that reset time. Because this error response contains no weekly quota figures, the weekly quota percentage on the card retains its previous reading, and the card also preserves the "Last checked" timestamp prompt, allowing you to keep track of prior usage status while waiting for the quota to recover.

items.original: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.
